text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The Monitoring Group renews it call to the south Lebanon combatants to undertake the necessary measures to protect civilians.
-Prime Minister Hariri discusses Lebanon's internal situation with Pope John Paul II.
-Weekend talks between President Hrawi and his Syrian counterpart Assad in Damascus stress the continuation of coordination on all ideas pertaining to the peace talks with Israel.
-Maronite Patriarch Sfeir continues his visit to Rome and will head for Brazil next Saturday.
-Islamic Resistance fighters discover three explosive charges on a road north of the western sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
